puzzle.hint: Allah's defense of the believers and His dislike of betrayal and ingratitude
puzzle.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍۢ كَفُورٍ
puzzle.verseEn: Indeed, Allāh defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
